Railway Gangway

Complete inter-car passenger passage systems for metro trains and passenger coaches, reviewed against vehicle geometry and operating movements.

Product overview

A railway gangway connects adjacent vehicles while allowing passengers to move between cars. The complete system may include bellows, end frames, a floor bridge, interior panels and interfaces to the vehicle body. Scope must be agreed at assembly level: a replacement bellows is not the same procurement item as a complete gangway.

Applications

Passenger coaches, metro vehicles and multiple-unit trains with an enclosed inter-car passage. New-build and replacement projects require a review of the existing car-end interface.

Technical information to confirm

  • Car-end mounting geometry and available installation envelope
  • Combined yaw, pitch, roll and longitudinal movement
  • Floor bridge arrangement, clear passage width and accessibility
  • Weather sealing, drainage and access for maintenance

Inspection and acceptance

Review the assembly drawing, mounting datums, passage clearance and movement envelope. Agree a functional articulation check and sealing assessment with the buyer before manufacture.

Material selection, test methods and any applicable fire, smoke or vehicle requirements must be confirmed for the project. No certification or interchangeability is implied by this listing.

Railway gangway application references

See installed gangway arrangements, passenger passage interiors and car-end interfaces. These photographs are supplied brochure references, not evidence of Railwheel-owned facilities or completed Railwheel projects. Configuration and suitability require project-specific review.

Source: customer-provided gangway brochure, application photographs on pages 11–12; partner reference material.

Packaging and shipping

Confirm packed dimensions, support points and storage limits after drawing review. Protect flexible folds from crushing and attachment profiles from distortion. Provide the destination, handling constraints and requested delivery terms for the shipping proposal.

Request a technical quotation

Send drawings, vehicle type, operating conditions, quantity and required delivery date to amy@railwheel.com. Amy Sun will coordinate a scope and feasibility review before quotation.

Please request model-specific photographs and drawings when making an inquiry.

Frequently asked question

Does a railway gangway include the floor bridge?

Not automatically. Specify whether the quotation must include the floor bridge, bellows, end frames, interior trim and vehicle mounting hardware.
